judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), updating two spec files, and adding an acceptance test (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without writing any production implementation code. None of the required source files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, etc.) or documentation (`CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`) were modified. Consequently, the new acceptance test suite will fail immediately on every test case because `list_conversations`, `UNSUPPORTED`, `StoreCannotList`, and `transport.history` do not exist.
